title: Epic v Apple: Judgment Day - Who Won? Who Lost? ...and Why? (VL538)
summary: Hoeg Law's Virtual Legality walks through the 185-page Epic v. Apple decision, covering antitrust law, relevant markets, anti-steering and who actually won. It runs well over two hours and corrects common media misreadings.
why: Strongly recommended as the best explanation of the ruling, in more depth and with more accuracy than press coverage.

quote.text: I'd suggest watching the excellent video by Hoeg Law.
